description: Smart meter data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Chen Chen. Load identification have shown significant performance gains in Chinese smart grids. Most existing load identification algorithms are based on electrical characteristics of steady or transient state, which are therefore limited by feature selection and analyzing pattern. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
